say:1:1330932001:1.text: With the palace in turmoil, the only thing we can do is carry out our duties.
say:1:1330932001:1.source_cn: 现在宫廷内外都有些混乱，也许我们唯一能做的，就是履行好...
say:1:1330932001:1.male: With the palace in turmoil, the only thing we can do is carry out our duties.
say:1:1330932001:1.female: With the palace in turmoil, the only thing we can do is carry out our duties.

say:2:1330932002:1.text: We must keep things in order until the new Archduke arrives!
say:2:1330932002:1.source_cn: 无论如何，在下一任大公到来之前，我们都不能允许白山失控！
say:2:1330932002:1.male: We must keep things in order until the new Archduke arrives!
say:2:1330932002:1.female: We must keep things in order until the new Archduke arrives!
